# ATM Ridwanul Haque

> Official portfolio of ATM Ridwanul Haque, development professional and Founder & CEO of Agroho Society in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Canonical pages
- English portfolio: https://atmridwanulhaque.com/
- Bengali portfolio: https://atmridwanulhaque.com/bn/
- Sitemap: https://atmridwanulhaque.com/sitemap.xml

## Profile
ATM Ridwanul Haque has over 15 years of experience in project design, implementation, monitoring and evaluation across poverty alleviation, WASH, inclusive finance, women’s economic empowerment, SME development, humanitarian response and public health. He is Founder and CEO of Agroho Society, a Dhaka-based non-profit focused on grassroots development.

## Main themes
- Soft Microfinance: a human-centred welfare-financing concept focused on dignity, affordability, borrower wellbeing and self-reliance; the site reflects the owner's supplied claim about registration of copyright in his name.
- WASH in Bangladesh: safe water, sanitation, hygiene behaviour change, school WASH, sanitation markets and resource recovery.
- Community and public health, including mobile healthcare services.
- Women's economic empowerment, menstrual hygiene management and community participation.
- Project design, programme management, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL).

## Selected experience
- Agroho Society: Founder & CEO, 2018–present.
- BRAC: Project Lead and Senior Sector Specialist across WASH programmes, consolidated as 2012–2018 in the supplied profile revision.

## Education
- Master of Development Studies, BRAC University, 2018.
- Master of Business Administration, listed in the supplied profile with Military Institute of Science and Technology / Bangladesh University of Professionals, 2010.
- Bachelor of Social Science (Honors), Jahangirnagar University, 2008.

## Publications
The publications section links to research and public writing on rural sanitation supply chains, faecal-sludge resource recovery, Soft Microfinance and humanitarian policy, hosted by Bangladeshi publishers and research repositories. Use each linked original publisher/repository for exact bibliographic metadata.

## বাংলা সারাংশ
এটিএম রিদওয়ানুল হক ঢাকাভিত্তিক উন্নয়ন পেশাজীবী এবং Agroho Society-এর প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও প্রধান নির্বাহী। তাঁর কাজের ক্ষেত্রের মধ্যে Soft Microfinance, অন্তর্ভুক্তিমূলক অর্থায়ন, পানি-স্যানিটেশন-স্বাস্থ্যবিধি (WASH), জনস্বাস্থ্য, নারীর অর্থনৈতিক ক্ষমতায়ন এবং উন্নয়ন কর্মসূচির মূল্যায়ন রয়েছে।
